add_top_of_queue: Add to the top of the queue
columns_hint: Which columns the torrent list shows on a computer. Also under “View” in the list.

creator_save_to: Also save on the server as

creator_source: File or folder on the server

limits_match_all: Only when all limits are reached

log_peers_text: Peers turned away by the IP filter or banned by hand.

login_text: With the credentials of the qBittorrent web UI.
manage_text: Categories decide the save path, tags are free.
name: Name
pause_session_hint: Pauses qBittorrent without changing the torrents' state.

plugins_text: qBittorrent's search plugins: enable, update, add.
pref_add_stopped_enabled: Do not start the download automatically
pref_add_trackers_enabled: Automatically append these trackers to new downloads
pref_add_trackers_from_url_enabled: Automatically append trackers from URL to new downloads
pref_announce_ip: IP address reported to trackers (requires restart)
pref_announce_to_all_trackers: Always announce to all trackers in a tier
pref_block_peers_on_privileged_ports: Disallow connection to peers on privileged ports
pref_bypass_auth_subnet_whitelist_enable: Bypass authentication for clients in whitelisted IP subnets
pref_bypass_local_auth: Bypass authentication for clients on localhost
pref_category_changed_tmm_enabled__false: Switch affected torrents to Manual Mode
pref_current_interface_address: Optional IP address to bind to
pref_delete_torrent_content_files: Always delete the files when removing
pref_dht: Enable DHT (decentralized network) to find more peers
pref_dont_count_slow_torrents: Do not count slow torrents in these limits
pref_embedded_tracker_port_forwarding: Enable port forwarding for embedded tracker
pref_enable_multi_connections_from_same_: Allow multiple connections from the same IP address
Allow multiple connections from the same Peer ID
pref_file_log_backup_enabled: Back up the log file after a size
pref_file_log_enabled: Write the log to a file
pref_hostname_cache_ttl: Internal hostname resolver cache expiry interval
pref_i2p_pex_enabled: Enable I2P Peer Exchange (I2P PeX) to find more peers (requires restart)
pref_limit_lan_peers: Apply rate limit to peers on LAN
pref_limit_tcp_overhead: Apply rate limit to transport overhead
pref_limit_utp_rate: Apply rate limit to µTP protocol
pref_lsd: Enable Local Peer Discovery to find more peers
pref_mark_of_the_web: Enable Mark-of-the-Web (MOTW) for downloaded files (require macOS or Windows)
pref_max_connec_per_torrent: Maximum number of connections per torrent
pref_max_outstanding_block_requests: Maximum outstanding block requests from a peer
pref_max_uploads: Global maximum number of upload slots
pref_max_uploads_per_torrent: Maximum number of upload slots per torrent
pref_peer_tos: Type of service (ToS) for connections to peers
pref_pex: Enable Peer Exchange (PeX) to find more peers
pref_preallocate_all: Pre-allocate disk space for all files
pref_reannounce_when_address_changed: Reannounce to all trackers when IP or port changed
pref_request_queue_size: Maximum outstanding requests to a single peer
pref_rss_auto_downloading_enabled: Enable auto downloading of RSS torrents
pref_rss_max_articles_per_feed: Maximum number of articles per feed
pref_save_path_changed_tmm_enabled__fals: Switch affected torrents to Manual Mode
pref_scheduler_enabled: Schedule the use of alternative rate limits
pref_socket_receive_buffer_size: Socket receive buffer size [0: system default]
pref_socket_send_buffer_size: Socket send buffer size [0: system default]
pref_start_paused: Start BitTorrent session in paused state
pref_temp_path_enabled: Use another path for incomplete torrents
pref_torrent_files_finished_backup_dir: Folder for copies of finished torrents
pref_torrent_files_finished_backup_dir_e: When torrent finished move backup to
pref_upnp: Use UPnP / NAT-PMP port forwarding from my router
pref_use_category_paths_in_manual_mode: Use Category paths in Manual Mode
pref_web_ui_secure_cookie_enabled: Enable cookie Secure flag (requires HTTPS or localhost connection)
pref_web_ui_upnp: Use UPnP / NAT-PMP to forward the port from my router
pref_webtorrent_stun_server: STUN server for WebTorrent NAT traversal

prefs_category_paths_hint: Saved as soon as you leave the field.
prefs_connection_text: Network, port, connections and how peers are found.
prefs_downloads_text: Where new torrents go and what happens when adding them.

prefs_rss_text: How often feeds are fetched, and the auto-downloader.

prefs_speed_text: Limits for all torrents together; empty means unlimited.
prefs_temp_path_hint: Only when everything is downloaded does it move to the target folder.

remove_delete_files_hint: Otherwise the downloaded files stay on disk.
rename_files_text: Search and replace in the names, with a preview.

rename_problem_duplicate: This name would then exist twice.
rename_tokens: In the replacement: $1, $2 … for groups, $d, $dd … for a running number.
rss_add_feed_text: The URL of an RSS or Atom feed.
rss_feed_error: The feed could not be loaded last time.
rss_pick_article: Pick an article to read it here.
rss_rule_cta_text: A rule is suggested from the title.
rule_episode_hint: Season x episodes, e.g. 1x2;8-15;20-; for episode 2, 8 to 15 and from 20 of season 1.

rule_pick: Pick a rule or create a new one.
rule_preview_text: Latest articles of the chosen feeds
rules_import_failed: The file contains no valid rules.
schedule_hint: Turns it on at the chosen time and off again afterwards.
search_failed: The search could not be started.

search_open_description: Open the description on the source's site
search_python: qBittorrent needs Python for searching. Please install it there.
settings_intro: The usual in plain words, every setting of qBittorrent under “All options”.

slow_mode_hint: Other limits, e.g. during the day
speed_chart_label: Speed of the last minutes, now ↓ {dl} and ↑ {up}
speed_edit_text: Apply to all torrents together. Empty means unlimited.
stats_disk_text: How fast qBittorrent reads and writes
stats_intro: What qBittorrent has transferred and how it is doing right now.
stats_speed_text: All torrents together, the last five minutes
